g.text: Res-KmeansFSQ: two K-means levels, then a grid
PART III · ESU SIDE: RES-KMEANSFSQ SEMANTIC IDS
category and usage: adaptive to the data
M¹ = M − NearestRep(M, C¹) C² = Kmeans(M¹, K)
Z = round( L · sigmoid(M² W) ), W ∈ R^(d×13), L = 2
fit on N > 10,000,000 sampled item embeddings (d = 3,000+)
But round(2·σ) gives 3 values per dim.
